nuggets.text: The Fighting Illini unveiled a 17,315-square-foot videoboard this season, described as the largest in college football.
Fighting Illini QB Katin Houser hit Ty Robinson for a 54-yard Hail Mary TD to end the first half vs. UAB after a defender bobbled it.
Katin Houser accounted for four touchdowns in his Fighting Illini debut after transferring from East Carolina.
Fighting Illini defensive coordinator Bobby Hauck took the job five days after announcing his retirement.
Fighting Illini DC Bobby Hauck never played college football; he ran track at Montana, where he later won 151 games as coach.
Fighting Illini coach Bret Bielema walked on at Iowa as a defensive lineman and became team captain as a senior.
Fighting Illini coach Bret Bielema grew up on an 80-acre hog farm near Prophetstown, Illinois.
The Fighting Illini won at Penn State in nine overtimes in 2021, the longest game in college football history.
The Fighting Illini won nine games in both 2024 and 2025, back-to-back nine-win seasons for the first time in program history.
The Fighting Illini's 40-7 Rose Bowl win over Stanford after the 1951 season was the first nationally televised college football game.
